en.headline: Woman injured after folding table falls from Cheung Sha Wan building
en.dek: Police arrested a 33-year-old man on suspicion of allowing an object to fall after a table dropped onto a car and grazed a 32-year-old woman’s hand on Monday evening.
body: Police arrested a 33-year-old man after a folding table fell from an industrial building on Cheung Shun Street in Cheung Sha Wan on Monday evening, injuring a woman and damaging a parked car.

The incident occurred at about 6.15pm outside Maxim’s Centre near 17 Cheung Shun Street. A 32-year-old woman was standing by the open boot of a private car when the table struck the vehicle and grazed her hand. She was taken to Caritas Medical Centre for treatment of a minor injury. Dashcam footage shared online showed the rectangular plastic table falling from a nearby podium level.

Officers arrested a man surnamed Yu, understood to be a tenant of the building, on suspicion of allowing an object to fall from a building. The case was handed to the Sham Shui Po District Crime Squad. On-scene measurements put the table at about 120 centimetres long, 55 centimetres wide and 100 centimetres high.

Under the Summary Offences Ordinance, it is an offence to drop or allow an object to fall from a building in a manner that endangers or injures persons near a public place. The offence carries a maximum penalty of a level-three fine and up to six months’ imprisonment. Police appealed for additional witnesses or drivers with footage to come forward.

zh.headline: 長沙灣大廈摺檯墮下傷女子 33歲男子涉容許物件墮下被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一傍晚一張摺檯從長沙灣長順街工廈墮下，撞及私家車並擦傷32歲女子手部，一名33歲男子已被捕。
body: 警方表示，周一傍晚約6時15分，長沙灣長順街近美心中心一幢工廈有摺檯從高處墮下，擦傷一名32歲女子手部並損毀一輛私家車。
事發時該女子正站在私家車尾箱旁。她被送往明愛醫院治理輕微受傷。網上片段顯示一張長方形塑膠檯從附近平台層墮下。
警方在初步調查後，拘捕一名姓余、33歲的男子，涉嫌容許物件從建築物墮下。他據了解是涉事大廈租客。案件交由深水埗區重案組第三隊跟進。現場量度該檯約長120厘米、闊55厘米、高100厘米。
根據《簡易程序治罪條例》，從建築物墮下或容許物件墮下而危及或傷害附近公眾地方人士屬違法，最高可判第三級罰款及監禁六個月。警方呼籲有目擊或行車紀錄儀片段的市民提供資料。
